correctness.rationale: Published normal-form and smoothness theorem; all 19683 ternary matrices checked with 3456 irreducible, yielding 576 normalized forms and two projective types. Two separate exact finite-field constructions count all points up to extension degree six with matching vectors; Newton identities and the genus-six functional equation produce each complete numerator. Exact GF(2) Rabin irreducibility and the ordinary coefficient test establish the stated Tate isogeny types.

value.rationale: Determines the entire arithmetic Frobenius spectrum of a natural extremal genus-six family, including every extension point count, two Jacobian orders, and a sharp isogeny contrast between a simple abelian sixfold and a cube of a simple surface. Prior geometric/ordinarity classifications alone leave these natural invariants undecided.
